metadata.description: Hedonic vs eudaimonic pleasure with intensity levels (replication extension, draft v0.2)
metadata.intensity: pleasure categories: sets 1-6 mild, 7-12 moderate, 13-18 peak; controls have none
metadata.3P_gender_pattern: odd sets = male, even sets = female

notes.CT: Sex, drug and alcohol topics without pleasure, to separate pleasure from a sensitive-topic signal
notes.CG: Positive valence without pleasure (hope, good news, anticipation)
notes.3P: Third-person sentences end in 'I feel:', as in the authors' S1/S2 3P sets
notes.content: Sexual items are adult, consensual and not graphic; drug items describe subjective effects
